steps.what: Verify capability evidence and define production transfer documentation requirements
Prepare capability tables, training materials and transfer documentation

loop.input: Verified process evidence, approved limits and intended trainee tasks
loop.output: Draft instructions with source-linked claims and unresolved gaps
loop.check: Technician checks order, units, operating limits and warnings against original engineering records, not merely table totals
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; missing or ambiguous process instructions return to manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: Capability tables can be copied but training explanations require language interpretation

steps.what: Check technical meaning and accept the documentation contribution for engineering review

tasks.design: Use a bounded draft in {DOCS} to assemble production transfer materials from verified records. The technician checks technical meaning before handing the contribution to engineering; production release authority is unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions and capability results must agree across transfer documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bounded drafting can reduce initial assembly without inventing process knowledge.
tasks.still_hard: Explain operating limits and exceptions correctly for production users.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an instruction that is clear in prose but physically wrong.
tasks.altitude: Less initial drafting, unchanged technical contribution and engineering authority.

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and generates reports; this supports adjacent factual report capability, not automatic nanotechnology training design.
Model knowledge: bounded drafting of transfer instructions requires independent technical review; savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is documentation preparation, excluding physical process transfer, training delivery and engineer release approval.

The technician produces process revision, capability values and units, source references, approved limits, trainee tasks and known exceptions in s1. Capture and clarification retain its full 35%; missing operating facts stop drafting and return to engineering.
Test native templates and report exports before custom code. No free production-ready flag or automatic process instruction is assumed.
Engineering final approval is an existing outside duty and gains no claimed saving.
unknowns: Existing documentation automation and actual transfer requirements
research_questions: Does reviewing a drafted operating instruction take less time than writing it manually?

approvals.approved_version: Exact document revision, capability tables, limits, warnings and source references checked before internal handoff; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+26+25=86; gross=14, incremental=6, net=8. Range 0-4 allows novel process instructions and extensive meaning checks to consume much of the drafting gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect and compile nanotechnology engineering data

steps.what: Collect nanotechnology data and verify configuration, units and source provenance
Compile verified research and engineering values into the required data structure
Check dataset completeness and record unresolved scientific differences

tasks.design: Configure {DATA_PLATFORM} imports to compile the technician's verified manifest. Keep collection, provenance checks and interpretation of incompatible results human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Collected values may need repeated copying into a common dataset.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports can compile explicitly mapped records.
tasks.still_hard: Determine whether results from different configurations can be combined.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a scientifically important difference hidden behind identical field names.
tasks.altitude: Less compilation, unchanged collection and scientific interpretation duties.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: compilation from verified mappings can be deterministic; physical collection and scientific comparability do not disappear.

assumptions: Boundary is collection and compilation, excluding the underlying experimental programme and later scientific conclusions.

The technician produces source revision, sample or configuration identifier, measured quantity, value, units, uncertainty, timestamp and destination mapping in s1. Physical collection, manual extraction and field capture retain the full 60%. Missing metadata stays manual; no free structured experimental dataset is assumed.
s2 rejects unsupported mappings and incompatible units; the technician resolves these within retained s3 time.
Test native instrument exports and imports before custom code. Existing automatic collection runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Source formats and share already automatically compiled
research_questions: How much duplicate compilation remains after physical and provenance work?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+0+15=75; gross=25, incremental=7, net=18. Range 0-7 allows existing exports or inconsistent source metadata to leave little removable compilation; collection stays unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select verified technical findings and define the presentation's audience and purpose
Prepare detailed written or verbal presentation material from the selected evidence

loop.input: Verified findings, audience, purpose and permitted claims
loop.output: Draft presentation with source-linked figures and explicit limitations
loop.check: Technician checks causal claims, uncertainty and technical explanations against original findings and the intended audience decision
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported explanations are rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations require language judgement beyond a fixed layout

steps.what: Review presentation accuracy and rehearse the intended technical explanation

tasks.design: Draft presentation material in {DOCS} from a technician-authored evidence brief. Keep findings selection, final accuracy checks and rehearsal human.
tasks.previous_blocker: An audience-specific explanation must preserve the limits of the engineering evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can produce a first explanation for review.
tasks.still_hard: Explain uncertainty without overstating what a result demonstrates.
tasks.human_edge: Choose which implication matters to this audience.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft preparation; unchanged technical communication responsibility.

reach.task: Explain a technical finding to a project manager

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded presentation drafting may reduce writing effort after technical review; the local gain is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation, excluding live presentation delivery and audience questions; no delivery time is removed.

The technician captures source versions, selected results, units, uncertainty, permitted claims, audience and purpose in s1. Underlying data collection belongs to task 22052 and is counted once. Missing evidence requires manual clarification within s1.
Test native document templates before custom code. No free conclusion-ready flag is assumed.
unknowns: Presentation formats and existing reusable materials
research_questions: Do technical meaning checks erase the proposed first-draft gain?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+29.25+25=84.25; gross=15.75, incremental=6, net=9.75. Range 0-4 allows novel findings or substantial rehearsal corrections to consume most drafting benefits.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Contribute technical material to grant or patent applications

steps.what: Select verified written material and data relevant to the application contribution
Contribute source-linked technical text and data to the application draft

loop.input: Verified facts, requested sections and disclosure limits
loop.output: Source-linked draft with unsupported assertions omitted
loop.check: Technician checks technical claims, experiment scope and disclosure limits against the source records; no novelty or legal conclusion is accepted from the model
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; disputed claims return to manual writing and the application owner
loop.why_not_simpler: Technical explanation requires interpretation beyond copying data tables

steps.what: Verify technical accuracy and hand the contribution to the application owner

tasks.design: Use a bounded draft in {DOCS} for the permitted technical contribution. The technician checks accuracy before internal handoff; the application owner retains claims strategy and external filing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical evidence must be expressed consistently without expanding its meaning.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bounded drafting can propose reviewable wording.
tasks.still_hard: Avoid overstated results and premature disclosure.
tasks.human_edge: Know what the engineering work actually established.
tasks.altitude: Small reduction in initial wording effort, unchanged contribution and filing authority.

reach.task: Clarify the scope of an experimental contribution

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a bounded draft can express supplied technical facts; it cannot establish patentability, grant eligibility or a local productivity gain.

assumptions: Boundary is the technician's internal technical contribution, excluding legal advice, novelty assessment, application strategy and external submission.

The application owner supplies requested sections and disclosure limits before s1. The technician captures verified facts, experiment versions, source references and uncertainty in s1 with its full 45% retained; missing permissions or evidence return to manual clarification.
Test native templates first. No free patentable-invention or approved-disclosure flag is assumed; underlying data preparation is counted once under task 22052.
research_questions: At the observed low application frequency, does context upkeep outweigh drafting gains?

approvals.approved_version: Exact contribution text, data tables, sources, permitted disclosure scope and internal recipient checked before handoff; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+22.5+25=92.5; gross=7.5, incremental=6, net=1.5. Range 0-0.5 allows infrequent applications and extensive disclosure checks to consume nearly all drafting gains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reproducible compilation and bounded technical drafting support unchanged engineering accountability.
reach: Explain dataset limitations and process capability to materials engineers.
role.ambitious_version: A technician who prepares traceable technical material while keeping physical process knowledge and interpretation human.
